messages:
devon: Quick follow-up from the postmortem on yesterday's cache eviction. I want to turn the high-priority fixes into a 2-week remediation sprint and update the triage/playbook so oncall can resolve faster. TL;DR: triage checklist, short commands, escalation path, and automated alerts. Please ack + pick owners.

jen_sre: Ack. I can own the triage checklist edits and the immediate runbook changes. Will draft by EOD. :+1:

maria_pm: Thanks. Can we surface the most common recurring pattern we saw? My read: hot-keys + large batch indexes + cold-started nodes. If true, we should add a pre-deploy check.

chris_platform: Agreed re: pattern. I'll take the automated guardrails (pre-deploy / admission webhook to detect big batching configs). Aim to prototype in week 1.

devon: Owner map so far: jen -> triage/playbook text, chris -> guardrail prototype, maria -> QA prompts & acceptance criteria, ian -> rollout priority/comm. I'll add jira tickets after we confirm scopes.

ian_product: OK. Prioritize: 1) triage clarity for oncall (short commands), 2) automated alerts for rising eviction rate, 3) pre-deploy checks. That order is important for lowering MTTI.

jen_sre: Working draft checklist items I'll add: 1) confirm eviction logs 2) check KV cache sizes 3) verify recent model/quant changes 4) confirm autoscaler events. Short command snippets included.

jen_sre: Example commands to add to playbook:
```
# Check recent eviction logs (last 30m)
journalctl -u redwood-inference --since "30 minutes ago" | grep -i eviction

# Inspect pod memory and GPU usage
kubectl top pod -n inference --containers | grep runtime

# Show autoscaler events
kubectl describe hpa -n inference runtime-hpa | sed -n '/Events:/,$p'
```

chris_platform: Nice. Add a quick health-check endpoint we can curl during triage: `/healthz?include=cache`. I'll add implementation notes.

devon: Escalation path update proposal: oncall -> oncall-senior (10m SLA) -> runtime-eng lead (30m) -> paging infra-sre (60m). Add requirement to open incident tracker within 5m. Thoughts?

maria_pm: That SLA ladder looks good. Suggest we also include a soft-fallback model routing step so customer-facing traffic can be routed to a cheaper but compatible model variant during remediation. Add a checklist item for that routing operation.

jen_sre: I'll bake that into the runbook with the exact commands. Example routing command for canary fallback: `curl -X POST https://console.redwood/api/v1/routing -d '{"route":"fallback-small"}'` (will add exact API call in doc).

opsbot: Created task <https://tracker.redwood.local/RED-4821|RED-4821> "Playbook: triage updates + short commands" and assigned to jen_sre.

devon: Thanks. Action items summary (please ack if you claimed):
• jen_sre: triage/playbook draft + commands (due in 48h)
• chris_platform: pre-deploy guardrail prototype + health endpoint (due 1 week)
• maria_pm: QA acceptance criteria & rollout comms (due 72h)
• ian_product: prioritize rollout and customer comm plan (due 72h)

chris_platform: Claiming chris_platform. Will post initial PR for health endpoint by EOD tomorrow.

jen_sre: Claiming jen_sre. Draft will be in #docs-sprint and link here when ready.

maria_pm: Claiming maria_pm. Will add test prompts and regression checks.

ian_product: Claiming ian_product. Will sync with sales/CS and draft comms.

devon: Great. Quick note on recurring incident pattern detection: I'll work with platform telemetry to add a weekly report that highlights increasing eviction events by model and node type so we can spot regressions earlier. Opsbot will create an alert when a model's eviction-rate crosses 0.5% of requests over a 10m window.

opsbot: Alert rule created: `eviction_rate > 0.005 over 10m` -> pager to infra-sre. Link <https://monitoring.redwood.local/alerts/eviction-rate|alerts/eviction-rate>.

jen_sre: One more runbook tweak: add a 'fast rollback' play for quant/compile changes with commands: `redwood-ctl versions rollback --model MODEL --to VERSION` and `kubectl rollout restart deploy/runtime --namespace inference` — include safety checks.

devon: Good call. Also add a short 'what to say' blurb for comms when fallback is enabled so CS has consistent messaging.

ian_product: I'll draft the blurb and include FAQ.

devon: OK, we'll reconvene in 48h to close the triage doc and confirm tickets. If anything blocks, ping me or @chris_platform. Thanks everyone. :pray:

jen_sre: Thanks — will update thread when draft is ready.

chris_platform: PR link to follow.

opsbot: Reminder set for 48 hours: "Triage runbook review" (calendar invite sent).
